name: How long does professional black spot (mold) remediation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional black spot (mold) remediation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of professional black spot (mold) remediation depends on the severity and extent of the infestation. A small, accessible mold patch might be addressed within one to three days. However, more extensive mold growth, especially if it's hidden behind walls or requires significant demolition and reconstruction, can take several days to a week or more. The process includes assessment, containment, removal, cleaning, and drying phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional mold remediation for black spots can take one to three days for small areas, but longer for extensive or hidden growth, depending on severity.
